title: story-025's mandated 'measure the delta and revert' safeguard is structurally incapable of firing on a below-par strategy (cross-repo: StableStakerV2._routeExit)
description: StableStakerV2._routeExit's guardUnderwater branch returns the FULL requested amount from StableStaker's own idle balance and calls relinquishPrincipal — a pure write-down (reflax AYieldStrategy.sol:700-716, NatSpec: 'vault shares are deliberately untouched'; body writes clientBalances and totalDeposited only, no external call). Therefore received == needed BY CONSTRUCTION, the mandated StableStaker: revert can NEVER fire, and story-025's acceptance test ('assert the idle buffer is untouched ... in the lying-preview scenario') passes trivially against a full-credit mock while being UNSATISFIABLE against a real below-par strategy. A green checklist here is a false negative.
impact: Availability, not value leak. The idle buffer is thin by construction (setSetAsideBuffer(address(stableStaker), 10) = 10% of skim proceeds, MigrateStableStakerMainnet.s.sol:597). One large staker's whole-position autoAnnihilate empties it, after which _routeExit takes revert('StableStaker: strategy underwater') and EVERY OTHER STAKER'S withdraw() IS BRICKED until the position recovers or the owner refunds. The safeguard story-025 mandated to catch exactly this cannot fire.
attackPath: The wired reflax strategy goes below par (true today for both Tokemak-Autopool direct strategies and the USDe market strategy).
A staker exits through _routeExit with guardUnderwater = true.
The branch pays the full requested amount out of StableStaker's idle buffer and writes the strategy principal down via relinquishPrincipal, which moves no assets.
received == needed, so the mandated revert never fires and nothing signals that the buffer absorbed the shortfall.
The buffer drains. The next staker hits revert('StableStaker: strategy underwater') and every subsequent withdraw() is bricked.
recommendation: In StableStakerV2._routeExit, measure the delta actually realized from the strategy rather than assuming the idle top-up satisfies the request, and make the underwater safeguard fire on the SHORTFALL rather than on received < needed (which cannot occur on this branch). Revise story-025's acceptance test so it is satisfiable against a real below-par strategy rather than only against a full-credit mock.
crossRepoNote: RESCOPED per validity-check §1 (VALID-IF-RESCOPED) and the run brief: the defect is ENTIRELY in StableStakerV2._routeExit, not in reflax previewExitFor. reflax's previewExitFor is not wrong here and relinquishPrincipal behaves exactly as documented.
